# MeraLawyer.pk

> MeraLawyer.pk is a legal services platform in Islamabad and Rawalpindi, Pakistan. It matches people with vetted, licensed advocates for family, criminal, property, corporate and overseas Pakistani matters, and provides legal services such as SECP company registration, FBR income tax return filing, NTN and sales tax registration, trademark registration, legal notices, court marriage, khula, succession certificates and property transfer. Fees are quoted upfront. Consultations in Urdu and English.

## Hire a lawyer

- [Family lawyer](https://meralawyer.pk/hire-a-lawyer/family-lawyer/): Hire a family lawyer in Islamabad and Rawalpindi for khula, divorce, child custody, maintenance and court marriage. Fee quoted upfront. Call or WhatsApp.
- [Criminal lawyer](https://meralawyer.pk/hire-a-lawyer/criminal-lawyer/): Urgent criminal lawyer in Islamabad and Rawalpindi for pre-arrest and post-arrest bail, FIR quashment, cyber crime and trial defence. Same-day help available.
- [Property lawyer](https://meralawyer.pk/hire-a-lawyer/property-lawyer/): Property lawyer in Islamabad and Rawalpindi for property verification, transfer, possession disputes, inheritance, rent and stay orders. Protect your property today.
- [Corporate lawyer](https://meralawyer.pk/hire-a-lawyer/corporate-lawyer/): Corporate and tax lawyer in Islamabad and Rawalpindi for SECP company registration, tax return filing, NTN, sales tax, trademarks and contracts.
- [Lawyer for overseas Pakistanis](https://meralawyer.pk/hire-a-lawyer/overseas-pakistani-lawyer/): Lawyer for overseas Pakistanis in Islamabad and Rawalpindi: property recovery, family cases, power of attorney, succession and attestation without travelling home.

## Legal services

- [Company registration](https://meralawyer.pk/legal-services/company-registration/): Register your private limited or single-member company with SECP. Name reservation, MOA and AOA, incorporation certificate and NTN. Fixed fee, done for you.
- [Income tax return filing](https://meralawyer.pk/legal-services/income-tax-return/): File your income tax return and wealth statement on FBR IRIS. Salaried people, freelancers, businesses and overseas Pakistanis. Become an active taxpayer.
- [NTN registration](https://meralawyer.pk/legal-services/ntn-registration/): Get your National Tax Number (NTN) from the FBR for individuals, sole proprietors, AOPs and companies. Online registration on IRIS, done for you.
- [Sales tax registration](https://meralawyer.pk/legal-services/sales-tax-registration/): Sales tax registration for goods with FBR and for services in Islamabad (ICT) or Punjab (PRA, Rawalpindi). Registration and monthly returns handled for you.
- [Trademark registration](https://meralawyer.pk/legal-services/trademark-registration/): Register your brand name or logo with IPO Pakistan. Trademark search, application, examination replies, opposition and certificate. Protect your brand.
- [Legal notice](https://meralawyer.pk/legal-services/legal-notice/): Send a legal notice drafted by an advocate in Islamabad or Rawalpindi for money recovery, defamation, rent, employment or a broken agreement. Fast turnaround.
- [Agreements and contracts](https://meralawyer.pk/legal-services/agreements/): Lawyer-drafted agreements in Islamabad and Rawalpindi: property sale, rent, partnership, employment, NDA and service contracts on correct stamp paper.
- [Court marriage](https://meralawyer.pk/legal-services/court-marriage/): Court marriage in Islamabad and Rawalpindi with nikah registration and NADRA marriage certificate. Same-day procedure, complete documentation by a lawyer.
- [Khula](https://meralawyer.pk/legal-services/khula/): Khula procedure in Pakistan explained by a family lawyer: filing in the family court, reconciliation, decree and Union Council certificate. Islamabad and Rawalpindi.
- [Succession certificate](https://meralawyer.pk/legal-services/succession-certificate/): Get a succession certificate or letter of administration in Islamabad or Rawalpindi through NADRA's Succession Facilitation Unit or the civil court. Lawyer-assisted.
- [Property verification](https://meralawyer.pk/legal-services/property-verification/): Verify property before buying in Islamabad or Rawalpindi: fard, land record, CDA or society record, litigation and seller identity checks by a lawyer.
- [Property transfer and registry](https://meralawyer.pk/legal-services/property-transfer/): Property transfer in Islamabad and Rawalpindi: sale deed registry, mutation (intiqal), gift deed (hiba) and inheritance transfer, handled by a property lawyer.
- [Power of attorney](https://meralawyer.pk/legal-services/power-of-attorney/): General and special power of attorney in Pakistan, including for overseas Pakistanis. Drafting, embassy attestation guidance and registration.
- [Bail application](https://meralawyer.pk/legal-services/bail-application/): Urgent bail lawyer in Islamabad and Rawalpindi for pre-arrest (498 CrPC) and post-arrest (497 CrPC) bail before sessions courts and the high court.
